build_dialog_babi_data: build the dialog_babi dataset by downloading and extracting data to the specified datapath directory
run_build_function: run the build function to download dialog_babi.tar.gz and mark the data as built
download_dialog_babi_resources: download the dialog_babi resources using the RESOURCES list of DownloadableFile entries
check_dialog_babi_built: check if the dialog_babi dataset has already been built using build_data.built
remove_outdated_dialog_babi: remove outdated dialog_babi data files using build_data.remove_dir before rebuilding
